test_title: PYST 6: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Kapil is sitting second to the left of Tia. Bhanu is sitting third to the right of Piya. Ritu is an immediate neighbour of both Tia and Bhanu. Kapil is an immediate neighbour of Arjun and Piya. Who is sitting between Bhanu and Kapil?
solution: Given: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Ritu is an immediate neighbour of both Tia and Bhanu. 2) Kapil is sitting second to the left of Tia.
